response.justification: Bogdan demonstrates deep distributed systems expertise through high-throughput roles at Dunnhumby and re:cinq, strong Python/TypeScript fluency, and hands-on experience with AI-agent infrastructure and developer tooling — aligning closely with the role’s agentic engineering focus. His ownership mindset is evident in founding open-source projects and leading cross-functional work, though limited explicit mention of on-call responsibility and agile ceremony leadership slightly tempers confidence.
strengths: Proven experience in AI-agent infrastructure and code generation tooling at re:cinq
Demonstrated mastery of distributed, high-throughput systems (e.g., millions of req/sec at Dunnhumby)
Strong full-stack ownership with open-source leadership and operational initiative
concerns: No explicit mention of on-call or incident response experience in recent roles
Limited detail on stakeholder coordination beyond engineering teams
German language proficiency is basic, potentially limiting local collaboration
